{{Quote|This is the Imperial Star Destroyer ''Chimaera'', calling the Overliege of Ukio. In the name of the Empire, I declare the Ukian system to be once again under the mandate of Imperial law and the protection of Imperial forces. You will lower your shields, recall all military units to their bases, and prepare for an orderly transfer of command.|[[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] ultimatum to the [[Ukian/Legends|Ukian]] [[Overliege]]|<ref name="TLC" />}}
The '''Battle at Ukio''' was a brief battle in the [[Thrawn campaign]] of [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]] where Imperial forces under [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] tricked Ukio into surrendering by using [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaked]] cruisers to bombard the planet from under the surface of the [[Planetary shield/Legends|planetary shield]] in coordination with an orbital bombardment by the orbiting Imperial fleet.<ref name="TLC" />

==Background==
{{Quote|Invisible only to those without eyes to see them.|[[Joruus C'baoth|Joruus C'boath]], commenting on the deployment of [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaked]] cruisers|<ref name="TLC" />}}
[[Ukio/Legends|Ukio]] was one of the five major producers of agricultural supplies for the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and was ruled by the [[Ukian/Legends|Ukian]] [[Overliege]]. Sometime prior to Thrawn's campaign, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] lost its control over Ukio.<ref name="TLC" />

In preparation for his attack on Ukio, the [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] had deployed some of his [[Thrawn's fleet (Galactic Empire)|fleet]] including the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]] [[Bellicose (Imperial-class)/Legends|''Bellicose'']], [[Judicator/Legends|''Judicator'']] and ''[[Nemesis]]'' and ''[[Death's Head]]'' on diversionary attacks on [[Ando Prime/Legends|Ando Prime]], [[Filve]], [[Crondre/Legends|Crondre]] and [[Ord Pardron/Legends|Ord Pardron]]. This was to distract the already stretched New Republic forces who had already sustained losses at the [[Battle for the Katana fleet|battle]] for the lost [[Katana fleet]]. For the attack itself, Thrawn deployed two Star Destroyers including his flagship the [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']], ten of the Katana [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|Dreadnaughts]] and an unknown number of [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaked]] [[Star Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]]. At his helm was the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Joruus C'baoth]] who would be responsible for coordinating the orbital bombardment of the cruisers via [[Battle meditation/Legends|battle meditation]].<ref name="TLC" />

==Description==
{{Quote|The cruisers are ready, Grand Admiral Thrawn. As am I.|[[Joruus C'baoth]] replying to Thrawn|<ref name="TLC" />}}
As the ''Chimaera'' and its escort of Dreadnaughts descended on Ukio's surface at high orbit above the sunside equator, Thrawn demanded that the Ukian Overliege submit to the Empire by lowering its planetary shield and withdrawing its military forces to their bases to await Imperial occupation. When the Ukians delayed a response, Thrawn retaliated by ordering the ''Chimaera'' to fire its [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser batteries]] on the planetary shield. As expected, the planetary shield deflected the blasts. But under the influence of C'baoth's [[Battle meditation/Legends|mind control]] technique, the two cloaked cruisers hovering beneath the shield at the two points fired upon by the ''Chimaera'' fired on the planetary surface in turn; obliterating two Ukian military air bases. Thanks to the near-instantaneous timing and the devastation sustained on the surface, the Ukians believed that Thrawn had developed a [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] capable of blasting through a planetary shield that could fit on a Star Destroyer.<ref name="TLC" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Then you will be part of the Empire, with all the rights and duties that implies.|Thrawn conversing with [[Tol dosLla]]|<ref name="TLC" />}}
Rather than incur more destruction, the Ukian Overliege surrendered to Thrawn and subjected to his terms of surrender. These terms included lowering Ukio's [[Planetary shield/Legends|planetary shield]] and allowing Imperial occupational forces to seize control of the [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generators]] and all ground-to-space artillery systems. All military vehicles larger than a command speeder were to be confiscated by the Imperial occupatiers. In exchange for accepting an Imperial military occupation, Thrawn also agreed not to interfere in the local political and social administration and to exempt Ukio from war-level taxation and military conscription. However, Thrawn also demanded that a significant proportion of Ukio's food production and processing facilities be diverted for the Imperial war effort. Rumors that the Empire had developed a [[superweapon]] capable of firing through a planet's defense shields spread throughout the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], although the New Republic, studying a [[Macrobinoculars/Legends|macrobinocular]] recording of the attack made by [[Samuel Tomas Gillespee|Samuel Gillespee]] and forwarded to them by [[Talon Karrde]], later disproved this belief.<ref name="TLC" />
